page.title: Add multiple garments
page.description: One photo creates one garment. Names and analysis are prepared automatically.
page.limits: Up to 200 photos, JPEG / PNG / WebP, up to 10 MB each.
page.drop: Drop photos here or choose files
page.concurrency: Up to 3 photos upload at a time. AI analysis runs separately in the queue.
page.keepOpen: You can continue using the app while uploading. Keep this tab open; the upload list is held in memory.
page.maxLimit: A batch can contain up to 200 photos. Choose fewer files or clear the completed batch.
page.readyMeaning: “Ready” means the catalog image has been prepared. AI suggestions may arrive later, including after Ollama is switched back on.
page.statusUnavailable: Could not refresh processing statuses. We will retry automatically.
page.clearDescription: Clearing the list does not delete saved garments or photos.
page.invalidType: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP file.
page.fileTooLarge: The image exceeds the 10 MB limit.
page.uploadFailed: The photo could not be uploaded.
